content: भगः (also भगम्)¦ [भज्-घ] .²1 One of the twelve forms of the sun; the sun. .²2 The moon. .²3 A form of Śiva. .²4 Good fortune, luck, happy lot, happiness; आस्ते भग आसीनस्य <ls>Ait. Br.</ls>; भगमिन्द्रश्च वायुश्च भगं सप्तर्षयो ददुः <ls>Y. 1. 282</ls>. .²5 Affluence, prosperity; ‘ओश्वर्यस्य समग्रस्य वीर्यस्य यशसः श्रियः . ज्ञानवैराग्ययोश्चैव षण्णां भग इतीरणा ..’; शमो दमो भगश्चेति यत्सङ्गाद्याति संक्षयम् <ls>Bhāg. 3. 31. 33</ls>. .²6 Dignity, distinction. .²7 Fame, glory. .²8 Loveliness, beauty. .²9 Excellence, distinction. .²10 Love, affection. .²11 Amorous dalliance or sport, pleasure. .²12 The pudendum muliebre; <ls>Y. 3. 88</ls>; गुरुतल्पे भगः कार्यः <ls>Ms. 9. 237</ls>. .²13 Virtue, morality, religious merit (धर्म). .²14 Effort, exertion. .²15 Absence of desire, indifference to worldly objects. .²16 Final beatitude. .²17 Strength. .²18 Omnipotence; (said to be {%n.%} also in the last 15 senses). .²19 <ab>N.</ab> of an Āditya presiding over love and marriage; <ls>Mb. 1. 227. 36</ls>. .²20 Knowledge. .²21 Desire, wish. .²22 The superhuman power of becoming as small as an atom, one of the eight {%Siddhis%} or powers of Śiva; see अणिमन्. .{@-गा@} .²1 (in <ab>comp.</ab>). Dignity, majesty; भूः कालभर्जितभगापि यदङ्घ्रिपद्मस्पर्शोत्थशक्तिरभिवर्षति नोऽखिलार्थान् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 82. 30</ls>. .²2 The female organ. .{@-गम्@} .²1 The asterism called उत्तराफल्गुनी; भगं नक्षत्रमाकम्य सूर्यपुत्रेण पीड्यते <ls>Mb. 6. 3. 14</ls>. .²2 The perinaeum of males.
